title: 嘉信策略师：九月加息，数据说了算？
speaker: Kevin Gordon

segments.en: And Kevin, I just want to come back to this whole idea of keeping an eye on that 2% inflation target, and what that ultimately means and expectations for, what is a very much live September meeting. Barclays came out saying they expect a hike in September and then another one in December. How are you thinking about the path forward?
segments.zh: 凯文，我想回到2%通胀目标的话题，以及这对九月会议意味着什么。巴克莱预计九月加息，十二月再加一次。你如何看待接下来的路径？

segments.en: So, we're still in the wait and see camp because I think that the first step to clearing the way for a rate hike in September is of course having someone like the chair come out and say we're very much actively considering it if the data point to that in that direction.
segments.zh: 我们仍持观望态度，因为九月加息的第一步是主席明确表示，如果数据指向加息，我们会积极考虑。

segments.en: So, the onus is really on that next set of inflation data. I think the labor market data probably still take a backseat to it, even if you get a strong job support next this coming Friday, I'm not so sure that that really changes the game or a week one. That doesn't necessarily change the game much. I think it's squarely rests on what CPI and PPI look like, and then ultimately how that maps over to PCE.
segments.zh: 因此，关键在于下一组通胀数据。劳动力数据可能退居其次，即使周五就业数据强劲，也不一定改变大局。重点在于CPI和PPI，以及它们如何映射到PCE。

segments.en: So, I do think that if it's firm or a little bit hot, that probably does give you a lock for September, but we have to wait and see what the rest of the FOMC says. So, it's still probably a little bit too early to assume that's going to be the case, but Worsh did mention that inflation is in his mind not going to come down just by itself back to target.
segments.zh: 如果数据稳健或略高，九月加息可能成定局，但还需等待FOMC其他成员的表态。现在假设还为时过早，但沃什提到，通胀不会自行回落到目标水平。

segments.en: So, at some point if you continue to see relatively sticky pressures, especially on the services side of the economy, which is where you're seeing a lot of stickiness and inflation, you're probably going to have to have the Fed respond to that sooner rather than later.
segments.zh: 如果服务领域持续出现通胀粘性压力，美联储可能不得不更早而非更晚做出回应。
